items.html: And this is the secret of "And these are the kings," etc. For we have already taught you that the hairs came out from the clarification of the kings and those Gevurot, and through the apertures of these hairs the light goes out to the kings below AA, to give them life, for the light is diminished in its going out from the narrow passage of the apertures of the hair, as above. For the hairs are the true correction for giving life to the kings, and then through these hairs they had the power to receive the light, and not before; only from this fourth correction of the Rosh of AA, from which the hairs came out, as mentioned, then they had the power to receive the light.
